You: Fuck you! Someday you are gonna get what’s coming to you! You piece of shit!
You: Goddammit! I lost all the money from my wallet! 
Let’s just go home now…{{wi}} There’s no point going after him.
I-It’s not like I can’t get it back! He beat me up only because of a surprise attack! If it wasn’t for that I would have completely trashed this guy! {{wi}}Probably…
I’m not going after him, because it’s a waste of time…{{wi}} and it’s cold.
